title: Australian research is helping China’s submarine warfare capabilities | The Strategist
paragraphs: Australia and its AUKUS partners are cooperating in oceanographic research with China that helps it develop the very submarine capabilities they’re spending billions to counter.
One Chinese military university is already converting international ocean observations into products useful for underwater warfare planning.
An AUKUS-wide audit is needed to identify scientific partnerships that could be strengthening China’s undersea military and intelligence capabilities.
